R-N1.note: FORWARD-OBLIGATION comment expanded to cover all three audit routes. GET /api/audit now has inline FORWARD-OBLIGATION (operation=read, resource=audit_trace). GET /api/audit/:instanceId likewise. GET /api/audit/export existing comment updated to explicitly state all three routes form a single hardening unit. Module docstring rewritten to list all three as ungated.

R-N2.note: Module docstring at top of audit.ts rewritten. Previous: 'PDP gate: same principal as GET /api/audit (observer role assumed for day-1 seed; production gates via PDP grant check)'. New: 'PDP gate: NONE in dev slice — all three audit routes (GET /api/audit, GET /api/audit/:instanceId, GET /api/audit/export) run without a PDP grant check. Hardening MUST close all three before production: add PDP operation=read on resource=audit_trace for each route (see FORWARD-OBLIGATION comments inline).' Correctly captures that GET /api/audit is open without any principal check, so export is NOT 'same as' the screen-read — it is stricter (401 gate), but both are ungated by PDP.

handoff_notes.audit_section_no_pdp: The entire audit section (GET /api/audit, GET /api/audit/:instanceId, GET /api/audit/export) runs without PDP in the dev slice. This is intentional — T-0053 seed-only data (hardcoded AUDIT_SEED fixture, not classified production data). FORWARD-OBLIGATION comments in dfe943b annotate all three routes as requiring a PDP gate before production. Candidate hardening task: 'PDP на audit-чтение/экспорт' — add operation=read, resource=audit_trace check to all three routes together with audit-aware masking (T-0033 maskFields). This task should be materialized before Stage-2 production promotion.
handoff_notes.claim_in_memory: POST /api/inbox/:id/claim stores claim state in an in-memory CLAIMED Map (process-lifetime). A server restart loses all claim state. This is the intended dev-slice behaviour — state reconstruction not required in dev. For production, claim state must be persisted to Postgres (recommended: add claimed_by + claimed_at columns to inbox seed table or external tasks table). Candidate hardening task: 'Persist claim state to Postgres'.
handoff_notes.new_task_disabled: The 'Новая задача' button is intentionally disabled with a tooltip ('Запуск нового процесса — будущая задача'). This corresponds to the Flowable start-instance API (start process instance via REST), which is not yet implemented in the dev slice. The forward-obligation is documented in shell.jsx. Candidate future task: 'Flowable start-instance — запуск процесса из UI'.

handoff_candidates.description: All three audit routes (GET /api/audit, GET /api/audit/:instanceId, GET /api/audit/export) lack PDP gate in dev mode. For production, all three must receive a PDP check: operation=read, resource=audit_trace. Additionally, AuditData payload fields (call/out) may contain sensitive runtime data in production and should be subject to T-0033 maskFields logic before export. This is a single hardening pass that must close all three routes together.
handoff_candidates.proposed_resolution: Add PDP check (grant-resolver validatePdp or equivalent) in each of the three registerAuditRoutes handlers before returning data. Add maskFields post-processing for audit payload fields that may carry classified data. Create as a separate hardening task targeting Stage-2.

handoff_candidates.description: CLAIMED map in inbox.ts is in-memory only (process-lifetime). Server restart loses all claim state. Acceptable for dev-slice but must be persisted before production deployment.
handoff_candidates.proposed_resolution: Add claimed_by + claimed_at to the inbox/tasks data store (Postgres table when T-0053 DB wiring is active). The _resetClaimStateForTests export can be preserved for tests. The claim endpoint should check DB atomically.

founder_walkthrough.purpose: T-0138 closes Gap-map Zone 6 (write-paths): 'Взять задачу' (claim), 'Экспорт лога' (export), 'Новая задача' disabled. All three UI buttons are now wired to live backend routes. This walkthrough confirms the write-path UX on the dev server.
prereqs: Server: PORT=8080 node dist/index.js (no DATABASE_URL needed — in-memory mode)
Build: npm run build && cd web && npm run build

screens.label: Входящие задачи
screens.note: Shows task list with 'Взять' button per pool task. Click 'Взять' on a pool task — button should change to 'Вы взяли' and POST /api/inbox/:id/claim should return 200.

screens.label: Аудит инстанса INS-7731

write_path_demo_steps.label: Claim task
write_path_demo_steps.action: Navigate to /inbox. Find a task with pool=true status. Click 'Взять'. Expect: button changes state, re-click is idempotent (same user = 200). Second user clicking same task = 409 ALREADY_CLAIMED.

write_path_demo_steps.label: Export audit log
write_path_demo_steps.action: Navigate to /audit. Click 'Экспорт лога'. Expect: browser downloads audit-INS-7731-<timestamp>.json with Content-Disposition: attachment header. File contains full AuditData shape (instance + trace).

write_path_demo_steps.label: New task disabled
write_path_demo_steps.action: On any screen with the 'Новая задача' button: button is disabled with tooltip 'Запуск нового процесса — будущая задача'. No action taken on click. This is the forward-obligation state until Flowable start-instance is wired.

founder_walkthrough.gate_outcome: If the founder confirms the write-path UX on dev (claim + export + disabled new-task), T-0138 can be merged to dev.

deviations_from_adr: No ADR changes. T-0138 is a write-path wiring task using the existing HTTP router (router.ts) and in-memory seed pattern (INBOX_SEED, AUDIT_SEED). No new architectural decisions. The CLAIMED map is an explicit dev-slice design: acknowledged in handler docstring and R-N1/R-N2 forward-obligation comments.
